title: Federation wake and executor recovery select pending work directly instead of paging all wake history (and never restart from the beginning after catch-up)
outcome: Federation wake and executor recovery select pending work directly instead of paging all wake history (and never restart from the beginning after catch-up)
acceptance: Federation mailbox-wake recovery and executor journal recovery select only unfinished or pending obligations directly, for example through an index on the pending predicate or an explicit pending set. Their per-pass work is proportional to pending items, not to all wake or journal history. After catch-up they don't reset to the beginning of history.

A behavioural regression with a large settled history and a late pending obligation, before and after a restart, recovers it within a bounded number of passes, with no duplicate delivery or execution.
Every hold or refusal states its reason. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.
